title: Speakers
drDigitalIntro:
Your speakers let you hear sound.
• They play music, videos, voice messages, and alerts.
• Sound comes out of small grilles on the sides or bottom of the laptop.
• No headphones needed — the sound goes straight into the room.
• If you want private audio, plug headphones into the headphone jack or connect them wirelessly via Bluetooth.
drDigitalSuccess: Those are the speakers. Now you know where the sound is coming from.
drDigitalHint: Take a look at your laptop, then click Continue whenever you're ready.
